title: LED Work Lights 90W – 7–9" for Truck & Tractor
descriptionHtml:
Powerful light for heavy vehicles

Trucks, tractors and boats need strong light to work safely in the dark. Weak lights make both the work and the driving harder.

90W of strong light in 7–9 inches

These work lights have 90W of power and come in 7 to 9 inches. They give a powerful floodlight beam and run on 24V – perfect for heavy vehicles.

Features

  • 90W of powerful light
  • Available in 7 to 9 inches
  • Runs on 24V
  • Durable and weather-resistant
  • Great for trucks, tractors, boats and jeeps

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
